'''Handler''' was a [[Subnode|subsystem]] of the [[Assembler]] known as [[Kud'ar Mub'at]]. Alongside [[Docker]], Handler secured approaching [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to the [[Ghostling Nest of the Assembler]] by utilizing its [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]]-adapted tentacles.<ref name="EGTAS">''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|The Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
